hard_rules: wow-service is the only framework dependency
one valid command method or tool call maps to exactly one service operation except protocol acknowledgements
workspace folder configuration and watched-file notifications each use one atomic service operation
all exposed operations come from the exact reviewed registry
no generic service MCP RPC shell script plugin model provider or filesystem operation
workspaces projects profiles and providers are never inferred from cwd Git editor or WoW installation
LSP profile is 3.18 over stdio and advertises only implemented capability projections
MCP profile is revision 2025-11-25 with stdio default and fixed read-only tools/resources
MCP prompts sampling elicitation tasks arbitrary roots and effecting default tools are absent
local daemon uses current-user named pipes or Unix-domain sockets and runs foreground
local MCP Streamable HTTP is loopback only Origin validated authenticated and disabled by default
document versions and position encoding are exact and stale changes require resynchronization
disconnect is not cancellation and progress is not completion
OutcomeUnknown is unsafe to retry and response replay never reexecutes service
backpressure is bounded and final results outrank progress and logs
multi-client source overlay authorization operation and result state is isolated
no automatic edit application editor setting mutation or source command execution
no sensitive material private source session secrets or raw handles in ordinary wire data logs or crash output
no public release packaging update or CI during E7-A documentation phase

required_before_first_rust_implementatio: implemented and frozen E7-A service operation registry session and overlay contracts
exact daemon LSP and MCP protocol adapter and library pins
all command method tool resource configuration endpoint output exit progress cancellation reconnect and isolation profiles
canonical wire request response error and shutdown vectors
measured message document queue source result concurrency latency and memory limits
all member and bundle SHA-256 values
